artifacts.name: agent-guidelines
artifacts.description: Agent working agreements for this repo: the rules that hold the cross-repo seams (content.blobs retention, DLQ split, the probe's and backup's least privilege, the OOM seam with archiver, mirrored constants), commit format, layout map.

artifacts.name: socraticode-doc
artifacts.description: Semantic search reference: tool table, the prefetch hook, per-tool notes, graph health and index scope, plus this repo's link stubs, one-host-per-projectId rule and measured index scope.

artifacts.name: stream-inventory
artifacts.description: The cluster stream inventory: every stream on db0, who produces, consumes and drains each, the DLQ suffixes, and the non-stream key patterns (replicator's volatile dedupe keys). Authoritative for stream ownership across the cohort.

artifacts.name: bus-health-contract
artifacts.description: The WARN-only health probe: per-stream retention contracts and their mirrored constants, the one threshold read off the stream rather than mirrored, stream, group, DLQ, loss, memory, disk and backup-freshness checks.

artifacts.name: memory-protection-doc
artifacts.description: The maxmemory cap on this instance: that all three producers survive OOM command not allowed without dropping or dead-lettering, which commands stay admitted at the cap, and why noeviction is load-bearing beyond refusing writes.

artifacts.name: undelivered-consumers-doc
artifacts.description: The group-undelivered check: why a pending count, XINFO GROUPS lag and consumer idle are each blind to a consumer that stopped calling XREADGROUP, the positions the probe compares instead, and the 5-minute threshold this repo owns.

artifacts.name: recovery-runbook
artifacts.description: Node or data loss: the hourly RDB backup to GCS and its findings, the restore staged as the AOF base under appendonly yes, and the rehearsal record.

artifacts.name: restart-runbook
artifacts.description: Restarting redis-server: the cohort restart window, the service identities that must come back, the tailnet bind race and its boot-race insurance, symptoms, and the 2026-09-10 incident.

artifacts.name: acl-cutover
artifacts.description: How the cluster moved onto per-service Redis ACL users, the order a new credential repeats, and which user each service holds.

artifacts.name: skills-doc
artifacts.description: The vendored agent skills: inventory, selection, the daily refresh hook and the weekly context measurement cadence.

artifacts.name: systemd-unit
artifacts.description: The artifacts this node deploys: redis.conf.broker (the OOM cap and noeviction policy), redis-acl.conf and its render script, the bus-health and backup units and timers, the tailnet-address wait, and deploy/README.md as the routing target for changing a grant.

artifacts.name: architecture
artifacts.description: Why this repo exists: the relocation out of archiver under archiver#193 D6, the seam that created, and what a neutral broker node does and does not own.

artifacts.name: project-config
artifacts.description: Dependency and tool contract: Python floor, the co-core wheelhouse find-links, ruff rule set including the no-inline-imports convention, and pytest config.
